title: Look Up mission
description: One mission per file in /missions. The filename must equal the id. The real checks live in scripts/validate-missions.ts; this schema is for editor autocomplete.

id.description: kebab-case, same as the filename without .json

title.description: Short and friendly, 3-24 characters, letters/spaces/hyphens only

time.description: When it fits. ["any"] must be the only entry if used.

sky.description: Which weather it fits. ["any"] must be the only entry if used.

instruction.description: One line, no screens. May use {sunset_time} (only with time golden/dusk) and {moon_status} (requires needs: moon).

needs.description: Only offered when the moon is up
